Tests verify tile seccomp setup and load balancing logic.

# Purpose
`test_verify_tile.c` is a C test file for the `verify` tile. It includes `fd_verify_tile.c` directly and uses mock topology objects, mock links, and local heap allocation with `malloc` to test tile setup and memory handling. The file checks seccomp rule setup in [`test_seccomp`](<#test_seccomp>) and checks input load-balancing logic in [`test_load_balance`](<#test_load_balance>), including the `before_frag` path for different input kinds and round-robin states. The [`main`](<#main>) function boots the runtime, runs the tests, frees test allocations, and reports success with `FD_LOG_NOTICE(( "pass" ))`.
